verification_categories_derived_from_spe: PCIe enumeration — Class Code 010802h detection, BAR0/BAR1 64-bit MMIO allocation, MSI-X capability discovery.
CAP register correctness — MQES / CQR / AMS / TO / DSTRD / NSSRS / CSS / BPS / MPSMIN / MPSMAX / PMRS / CMBS read-back.
VS register correctness — major.minor.tertiary version reflected in 32-bit register.
Controller initialization — AQA/ASQ/ACQ programming + CC.EN=1 → CSTS.RDY=1 within CAP.TO.
Controller Reset — CC.EN 1→0 → CSTS.RDY 1→0; I/O queues purged; Admin queue preserved.
NVM Subsystem Reset (if CAP.NSSRS=1) — NSSR magic 0x4E564D65 → reset → CSTS.NSSRO=1.
Normal Shutdown — CC.SHN=01b → drain → flush → CSTS.SHST=00b/01b/10b sequence.
Abrupt Shutdown — CC.SHN=10b → CSTS.SHST=10b without drain.
Admin SQ doorbell + Admin CQE roundtrip — Identify Controller (CNS=01h) + 4 KB response in PRP.
Identify Controller field validation — VID, SSVID, SN (20 chars), MN (40 chars), FR (8 chars), CNTLID, VER mirror.
Identify Namespace (CNS=00h) for each active NSID — NSZE / NCAP / NUSE / LBAF[] / FLBAS / MC / DPC / DPS / NMIC / RESCAP / NGUID / EUI64.
Active NSID List (CNS=02h) - validate sorted ascending list of active NSIDs.
Set/Get Features round-trip — Number of Queues (FID=07h), Temperature Threshold (04h), APST (0Ch), HMB (0Dh).
Create I/O CQ then Create I/O SQ — verify CQE status; verify SC=0x01 Invalid Queue Identifier on missing CQ.
Delete I/O SQ then Delete I/O CQ — verify SC=0x0C Invalid Queue Deletion on out-of-order delete.
I/O Write + Read consistency — write known pattern, read back, verify match.
I/O Flush — verify all pending writes durable after Flush completes.
Compare — verify match returns SC=0, mismatch returns SC=0x85.
Compare-and-Write Fused — atomic semantics: success path + failure path.
Write Zeroes — verify range zeroed.
Write Uncorrectable — verify subsequent read returns Unrecovered Read Error (SC=0x281).
Dataset Management Deallocate (AD=1) — verify deallocated LBA returns deterministic data (0s or 0xFFs per DLFEAT).
PRP single-page, two-page, and PRP-List multi-page transfers — verify data integrity.
PRP Offset Invalid (SC=0x13) — inject non-zero offset on PRP List entry; verify error.
SGL (PSDT=01b/10b) round-trip if controller advertises SGL support — verify Data Block / Bit Bucket / Segment / Last Segment / Keyed / Transport SGL.
Malformed SGL — Invalid SGL Segment / Length / Number / Type / Data Block Granularity (SC=0x0D..0x11/0x1E).
Phase Tag wraparound — fill CQ, drain, fill again; verify Phase Tag inverts on each pass.
Doorbell stride — verify SQyTDBL / CQyHDBL at correct (4<<CAP.DSTRD) stride for y>0.
Invalid Doorbell Write Value — write past Tail; verify Async Event Notice generated (if AER outstanding).
Asynchronous Event Request — post AER, trigger event (temp threshold, log change), verify CQE event class + log identifier.

Get Log Page coverage — Error Information (LID=01h), SMART (02h), Firmware Slot (03h), Changed NS List (04h), Commands Supported & Effects (05h), Self-Test (06h), Telemetry HI/CI (07h/08h), Endurance Group (09h), Predictable Latency NVM Set (0Ah), Predictable Latency Event Aggregate (0Bh), ANA (0Ch), Persistent Event (0Dh), LBA Status (0Eh), Endurance Group Event Aggregate (0Fh), Sanitize Status (81h).
Firmware Image Download + Firmware Commit — verify slot programmed; verify Activation Requires Reset/NSSR.
Format NVM — verify namespace reformatted with selected LBAF; verify Format In Progress (SC=0x84) blocks during operation.
Sanitize — Block Erase / Crypto Erase / Overwrite + status log progress + competing-command blockage (SC=0x1D).
Namespace Management Create/Delete — verify NSID allocated; verify NS Allocated List updated.
Namespace Attachment Attach/Detach — verify NS Active List updates per attached controller.
Abort — target specific (SQID, CID); verify SC=0x07 on target completion; verify ACL not exceeded (SC=0x03).
Keep Alive — verify timer reset by Keep Alive command; verify Keep Alive Timer Expired (SC=0x19) if KATO exceeded.
Device Self-Test — Short / Extended / Abort; verify Device Self-Test log populated.
Reservation Register / Acquire / Release / Report — multi-controller reservation conflict (SC=0x83).
Boot Partition Read (if CAP.BPS=1) — BPRSEL → BPMBL buffer fill → BPINFO.BRS transitions.
Controller Memory Buffer (if CAP.CMBS=1) — host places SQ/CQ in CMB; verify operation; verify SC=0x12 on unsupported CMB use.
Persistent Memory Region (if CAP.PMRS=1) — verify PMRSTS.NRDY clears before access; verify persistence per PMRCAP.PMRWBM.
ANA — Asymmetric Namespace Access Reporting; ANA Log (LID=0Ch); ANA Group state transitions.
SR-IOV (if implemented) — Virtualization Management (OPC=1Ch) to allocate flexible vs private resources to VFs; verify each VF presents independent NVMe controller and Identify Controller fields.
Predictable Latency Mode (PLM) — NVMe 1.4; per-NVM-Set deterministic latency window.
Read Recovery Level (RRL) — NVMe 1.4; Set Features FID 12h.
fields.notes: NVMe Base 1.4 does not embed a formal verification plan. NVM Express, Inc. publishes the NVMe Compliance Test Suite (NVMe-CTS) used by the UNH-IOL NVMe Integrators List for plugfest interop testing; CTS test cases derive from sections 3 (registers), 4 (data structures), 5 (Admin), 6 (NVM I/O), 7 (Controller Architecture), 8 (Features), 9 (Directives), 10 (Error Reporting).
